question: What outcomes can a successful mitigating circumstances application lead to?
gold_answer: Mitigations include removing the late penalty, resit as same opportunity, disregarding a component, mapping a grade, or presenting to the progression/award board.
answer: A successful mitigating circumstances application at Heriot-Watt University will not result in your marks or grades being directly increased. Instead, it can lead to outcomes such as an extension on coursework submission deadlines, an uncapped deferred assessment (treated as a first attempt), or having an affected attempt set aside. Additionally, the Exam Board may take your circumstances into account when making decisions regarding your academic progression or final degree classification.
